statements.text: Moon phases are changes in the bright part of the Moon seen from Earth.
The Moon itself swells and shrinks to make the changing bright shapes.
The Moon does not emit its own light; the bright part is sunlight reflected to Earth.

stem:
Nidhi sketches the Moon on several nights and sees the bright part change shape. She wonders what a phase is.

Which statements are correct?

teacher.key_rationale: Phases are changes in the bright part seen from Earth. The Moon does not change its own solid shape, and it reflects sunlight rather than emitting its own light.
